setting.ai.agent.commandTimeoutSeconds.d: How long, in seconds, a command the agent runs (after you allow it) may take before it is stopped.
setting.ai.agent.maxSteps.description: The most tool calls agent mode makes for one question before it stops and summarizes.
setting.ai.agent.maxSteps.title: Agent Step Limit
setting.ai.agents.description: External coding agents AI Chat can run over the Agent Client Protocol (ACP), each your own CLI. AI: Connect to an Agent… sets one up, tests it and writes its entry here; by hand: { "name": { "command": "…", "args": ["…"], "env": { }, "secretEnv": ["NAME"] } }, where secretEnv names variables whose values Connect keeps in the OS credential store, never in this file. They use their own provider and data policy; Codalus checks what they ask the IDE for. They run only while AI assistance is on, in trusted folders. Read from your user settings only.
setting.ai.agents.title: External Agents
setting.ai.chat.agent.description: Who answers in AI Chat: empty for the built-in assistant, or the name of an agent of External Agents (ai.agents). AI Chat's picker writes it, so the chat opens with the agent you chose last.
setting.ai.chat.agent.title: AI Chat Agent
setting.ai.chat.maxContextCharacters.des: The most characters of context (selection, files, errors, build output) sent with a question. What goes over is cut, and the chat says so.
setting.ai.completions.delayMilliseconds: How long typing pauses, in milliseconds, before a suggestion is asked for.
setting.ai.completions.enabled.descripti: Suggest code as you type, shown in gray at the caret: Tab accepts, Ctrl+Right accepts a word, Esc dismisses. It sends the text around the caret to the provider as you type, so it has its own switch, off by default.
setting.ai.completions.enabled.title: Inline Suggestions
setting.ai.completions.model.description: The provider's model for inline suggestions, when it should be a faster one than the chat's. Empty: the chat's model.
setting.ai.completions.model.title: Inline Suggestions Model
setting.ai.enabled.description: Turn on AI assistance: the AI Chat window and the AI commands. Off by default; nothing is sent anywhere until you also choose a provider. A workspace's settings can turn it off there, never on.
setting.ai.enabled.title: Enable AI Assistance
setting.ai.exclude.description: Files never sent to a language model, as .gitignore patterns relative to the workspace (for example secrets/ or **/*.local.json). Files that .gitignore or a .codalusignore excludes, and files that hold secrets by name (.env, *.pfx, *.key, secrets.json…), are never sent either.
setting.ai.exclude.title: Exclude
setting.ai.mcp.servers.description: MCP servers whose tools agent mode may use, each call after you allow it: { "name": { "command": "…", "args": ["…"], "env": { } } }. Read from your user settings only.
setting.ai.mcp.servers.title: MCP Servers
setting.ai.mcpServer.enabled.description: Let AI agents that run outside the IDE reach it through `codalus mcp` (an MCP server over stdio): the solution, the open files, the Error List and the build output; a build asks you first. For your user only; off by default.
setting.ai.mcpServer.enabled.title: MCP Server
setting.ai.model.description: The provider's model to use. Empty: the provider's first model.
setting.ai.model.title: Model
setting.ai.nextEdit.enabled.description: After you edit, suggest the next edit nearby (the same rename further down, a matching change): the lines show highlighted with the new text beside them, Tab applies it, Esc dismisses it. It sends your recent edits and the lines around the caret, so it has its own switch, off by default.
setting.ai.nextEdit.enabled.title: Next Edit Suggestions
setting.ai.provider.description: The language model provider requests go to (a provider plugin's id: openai, ollama, anthropic, or a third-party plugin's). Empty: none, and nothing is sent.
setting.ai.provider.title: Provider
setting.android.jdkDirectory.description: The JDK's folder for Android builds (JDK 17 or later). Empty: JAVA_HOME, then the usual folders.
setting.android.jdkDirectory.title: Java Development Kit Location
setting.android.sdkDirectory.description: The Android SDK's folder. Empty: ANDROID_HOME, then the usual folders (Android Studio's).
setting.android.sdkDirectory.title: Android SDK Location
setting.build.beforeRun.description: What F5 and Ctrl+F5 do before starting a project.
setting.build.beforeRun.enum.build: Build it (quick when it is up to date)
setting.build.beforeRun.enum.prompt: Ask when it is out of date
setting.build.beforeRun.title: Before Running
setting.build.binaryLog.description: Capture each build in a .binlog in the logs folder (the newest 20 are kept), for the binary log viewer and Build Timings.
setting.build.binaryLog.title: Write a Binary Log for Every Build
setting.build.fastUpToDateCheck.descript: Skip MSBuild when nothing a project builds from changed since its last build here (projects can opt out with DisableFastUpToDateCheck).
setting.build.fastUpToDateCheck.title: Fast Up-to-Date Check
setting.build.logFileVerbosity.descripti: Also write the build's log to build.log in the logs folder (Build: Open Build Log), at this verbosity.
setting.build.logFileVerbosity.title: Build Log File Verbosity
setting.build.maxParallelProjects.descri: How many projects MSBuild builds at once (its nodes). 0: one per processor.
setting.build.maxParallelProjects.title: Maximum Parallel Project Builds
setting.build.runAnalyzersDuringBuild.de: Run Roslyn analyzers during builds (RunAnalyzersDuringBuild). Live analysis in the editor isn't affected.
setting.build.runCustomToolsOnSave.descr: When a file with a custom tool (.resx, a text template…) is saved, generate its output.
setting.build.runCustomToolsOnSave.title: Run Custom Tools on Save
setting.build.saveAllBeforeBuild.descrip: Save every modified document before a build starts.
setting.build.saveAllBeforeBuild.title: Save All Before Build
setting.build.verbosity.description: How much MSBuild writes to Output → Build.
setting.build.verbosity.enum.detailed: Detailed: also the targets and low-importance messages
setting.build.verbosity.enum.normal: Normal: also the projects, command lines and copies
setting.build.verbosity.title: Build Output Verbosity
setting.codeCleanup.fixes.description: Diagnostic ids whose fixes Code Cleanup applies (empty: unused usings, simplified names, braces, accessibility modifiers, readonly fields, new(), file-scoped namespaces). Then it sorts usings and formats.
setting.codeCleanup.fixes.title: Code Cleanup Fixes
setting.codeCleanup.onSave.description: Run Code Cleanup on C# files before they are saved.
setting.codeCleanup.onSave.title: Run Code Cleanup on Save
setting.codeSearch.grouping.description: Show results in one list ranked best first, or grouped by kind: files, types, members, then text.
setting.codeSearch.grouping.title: Result Grouping
Also find the types of the referenced assemblies (NuGet packages and the framework); they open decompiled, or from their embedded or Source Link source.
setting.codeSearch.scope.description: Where Code Search looks: the entire solution, the current document's project, or the current document. The scope picker in the window changes it.
setting.codeSearch.scope.title: Scope
setting.codeSearch.textResults.descripti: The most lines a text search lists (Find in Files' engine, for queries of three characters or more, or with x:). 0 turns text results off.
setting.codeSearch.textResults.title: Text Results
setting.containers.fastMode.description: Run and debug a project in a container of its Dockerfile's base stage with the build output mounted, so a rebuild needs no image build. Off: the whole Dockerfile is built every time, and debugging attaches to the app.
setting.containers.fastMode.title: Fast Mode
setting.containers.tool.description: The container CLI that builds, runs and lists containers: docker, podman, or a command line such as 'wsl -d Ubuntu --exec podman'. Empty: docker when it is installed, else podman.
setting.containers.tool.title: Container Engine
setting.data.maxRows.description: The query editor shows at most this many rows of each result set; the results say when they were cut.
setting.data.maxRows.title: Maximum Rows per Result
setting.data.pageSize.description: Rows per page when viewing and editing a table's data.
setting.data.pageSize.title: Table Data Page Size
setting.debug.adapter.description: The debugger that debugs .NET programs from the next session: netcoredbg, or the Codalus debugger, Codalus IDE's own (a preview). The Codalus debugger reports exit codes on macOS, evaluates casts and C#'s operators, and starts programs in the integrated terminal on every OS, stopping on Main's first line; it doesn't yet debug remote targets or x64 programs on Apple silicon, which netcoredbg debugs then (the Debug Console says so). .NET Framework programs have their own debugger.
setting.debug.adapter.title: Debugger for .NET programs
setting.debug.browser.description: The browser for debugging in the browser (Blazor WebAssembly, JavaScript): auto (Chrome, then Edge, then Chromium), chrome, edge, chromium, or the path of a Chromium browser.
setting.debug.browser.title: Browser
setting.debug.codalusOffer.description: When you save an edit while netcoredbg debugs a program, offer once to debug with the Codalus debugger, which applies edits to the program while it's debugged.
setting.debug.codalusOffer.title: Offer the Codalus debugger for edits
setting.debug.console.description: Where a console or web app debugged with Start Debugging gets its console: the Debug Console (output only), the integrated terminal, or a console window of its own (Windows, the default there). The terminal and the console window take input, and Detach All leaves the program running.
setting.debug.console.title: Console of debugged programs
setting.debug.containerTool.description: The container command line for attaching in containers: docker, podman, or one inside WSL such as "wsl -d Ubuntu --exec podman". Empty: the Containers window's engine (containers.tool, else docker when it is installed, else podman).
setting.debug.containerTool.title: Container tool
setting.debug.hotReload.description: Saving a file applies the edit to the program being debugged. Under the Codalus debugger (Debugger for .NET programs) every program takes C#, Visual Basic and Razor edits while debugged: Apply Code Changes (Alt+F10) applies them any time, and Continue applies the ones made while stopped. Start Debugging also runs a Blazor WebAssembly app's dev server, and a Blazor Web App's server, under dotnet watch, so WebAssembly components take edits in the browser; in a Blazor Web App the debugger attaches to the server once it starts (breakpoints in its Program.cs debug it from the start, without Hot Reload), and edits that need a restart restart the app. Under netcoredbg the .NET runtime doesn't apply edits to a program the debugger runs: the server keeps the code it started with until you restart, and other apps need Start with Hot Reload.
setting.debug.hotReload.title: Hot Reload while debugging
setting.debug.javaScript.description: Start Debugging opens an ASP.NET Core app's page in Chrome or Edge under the debugger, when its launch profile opens a browser, so breakpoints in its scripts bind too. Blazor WebAssembly components always debug in the browser.
setting.debug.javaScript.title: JavaScript debugging for ASP.NET Core
setting.debug.justMyCode.description: Step through and break in your own code only (optimized and framework code is stepped over).
setting.debug.justMyCode.title: Just My Code
setting.debug.liveVisualTree.description: Running or debugging an Avalonia app, or a WPF app on Windows, loads Codalus IDE's agent into it (a .NET startup hook), for the Live Visual Tree and Live Property Explorer.
setting.debug.liveVisualTree.title: Live Visual Tree for Avalonia and WPF apps
setting.debug.perfTips.description: Show the time elapsed since the program was resumed at the end of the current statement's line.
setting.debug.perfTips.title: PerfTips
setting.debug.sourceFileMap.description: Source folders of programs debugged on another machine, as "/folder/there=C:\folder\here". Without one, a file is found in the solution by its folder and name.
setting.debug.sourceFileMap.title: Source file map
setting.debug.stepOverPropertiesAndOpera: Step Into steps over property getters and setters and operators (applies from the next session).
setting.diagnostics.crashReports.descrip: When Codalus IDE crashes, save a report (version, OS, the error and recent log lines) in the logs folder on this computer. Nothing is sent anywhere.
setting.diagnostics.crashReports.title: Save Crash Reports
setting.diagnostics.showDiagnosticToolsO: Open the Diagnostic Tools window (CPU, memory, GCs, exceptions and the runtime's counters) when a debug session starts. While it is open, it follows the program being run or debugged either way.
Show Diagnostic Tools When Debugging Starts
setting.editor.autoClosingBrackets.descr: Insert the closing bracket or quote after typing an opening one, as the language defines them.
setting.editor.autoClosingBrackets.title: Auto Closing Brackets
setting.editor.bracketPairColorization.d: Color matching brackets by nesting depth. By default it's off in the Classic themes and on in the others.
setting.editor.codeLens.description: Show reference and implementation counts at the end of declarations.
setting.editor.codeLens.title: CodeLens

setting.editor.formatOnType.description: Format the statement or block after typing ; or }.
setting.editor.formatOnType.title: Format on Type
setting.editor.gitCodeLens.description: Show each member's last author and when, and its numbers of authors and changes, from Git blame (files in a repository).
setting.editor.gitCodeLens.title: CodeLens: Git History
setting.editor.guides.indentation.descri: Draw vertical lines at indentation levels.
setting.editor.guides.indentation.title: Indentation Guides
setting.editor.highlightCurrentLine.desc: Highlight the line with the caret.
setting.editor.inheritanceMargin.descrip: Show glyphs for members that implement, override or are overridden, with navigation.
setting.editor.inheritanceMargin.title: Inheritance Margin
setting.editor.inlayHints.parameterNames: Show parameter names before literal and new arguments.
setting.editor.inlayHints.types.descript: Show the inferred types of var declarations and lambda parameters.
setting.editor.inlayHints.types.title: Inlay Hints: Types
setting.editor.inlineDiagnostics.descrip: Show error and warning messages at the end of their line.
setting.editor.inlineDiagnostics.title: Inline Diagnostics
setting.editor.insertSpaces.description: Indent with spaces instead of tabs. An .editorconfig file overrides it.
setting.editor.insertSpaces.title: Insert Spaces
setting.editor.lineNumbers.title: Line Numbers
setting.editor.minimap.enabled.descripti: Show a miniature of the document beside the editor.
setting.editor.minimap.enabled.title: Minimap
setting.editor.navigationBar.description: Show the type and member drop-downs above the editor.
setting.editor.navigationBar.title: Navigation Bar
setting.editor.overviewRuler.description: Mark errors, warnings, changes, breakpoints, find results and the caret beside the scroll bar.
setting.editor.overviewRuler.title: Overview Ruler
setting.editor.pasteAddsImports.descript: Add the usings (Imports) that pasted C# or Visual Basic code needs, when the namespace is unambiguous or the one it was copied under.
setting.editor.pasteAddsImports.title: Add Missing Usings on Paste
setting.editor.renderWhitespace.title: Render Whitespace
setting.editor.rulers.description: Columns at which to draw vertical rulers, e.g. 120.
setting.editor.rulers.title: Rulers
setting.editor.stickyScroll.description: Keep the headers of the enclosing scopes at the top of the editor while scrolling.
setting.editor.stickyScroll.title: Sticky Scroll
setting.editor.tabSize.description: Columns per indentation level. An .editorconfig file overrides it.
setting.editor.tabSize.title: Tab Size
setting.editor.testCodeLens.description: Show each test's last outcome, and how many of a test class's tests pass.
setting.editor.testCodeLens.title: CodeLens: Test Status
Colors over the theme's for kinds of code, as VS Code writes them: "comments", "strings", "keywords", "numbers", "types", "functions", "variables", or "semanticTokenColors" by token type; under "[Dark]" (a theme's name) for one theme only. Tools → Fonts and Colors edits them.
setting.editor.wordWrap.description: Wrap long lines in the editor.
setting.editor.wordWrap.title: Word Wrap
setting.errorList.groupBy.description: How the Error List groups its diagnostics. Groups collapse with a click.
setting.errorList.groupBy.title: Group By
setting.files.autoRecover.description: Back up unsaved changes every 30 seconds and offer to restore them after a crash.
setting.files.autoRecover.title: AutoRecover
setting.fsharp.analyzers.description: Run F# analyzers (FSharp.Analyzers.SDK) as you type, from the F# Analyzers Path folders. Analyzers are code, so they run only in trusted folders, like the language service.
setting.fsharp.analyzers.title: F# Analyzers
setting.fsharp.analyzersPath.description: The folders F# analyzers are loaded from, separated by semicolons, relative to the solution's folder.
setting.fsharp.analyzersPath.title: F# Analyzers Path
setting.fsharp.completeUnopenedNamespace: Completion offers types and modules of namespaces that aren't opened yet, and adds the open declaration.
setting.fsharp.fsiExtraParameters.descri: More options for dotnet fsi, separated by spaces (e.g. --langversion:preview --optimize+). They apply when F# Interactive starts.
setting.fsharp.fsiExtraParameters.title: F# Interactive Options
setting.fsharp.inlayHints.description: Show inferred types and parameter names in the editor.
setting.fsharp.inlayHints.title: Inlay Hints
setting.fsharp.languageService.descripti: F# editing uses FsAutoComplete and Fantomas, installed once into the cache folder with dotnet tool install: ask before installing, install without asking, or don't use them.
setting.fsharp.languageService.enum.ask: Ask the first time an F# file opens
setting.fsharp.languageService.title: F# Language Service
setting.fsharp.linter.description: Report FSharpLint's suggestions as you type.
setting.fsharp.linter.title: Linter
setting.fsharp.referencesCodeLens.descri: Show how many references each definition has above it.
setting.fsharp.referencesCodeLens.title: References CodeLens
setting.fsharp.signatureCodeLens.descrip: Show each function's inferred signature above it.
setting.fsharp.signatureCodeLens.title: Signature CodeLens
setting.git.diff.layout.description: How a file's diff shows its two versions. The diff's gear menu changes it too.
setting.git.diff.layout.enum.inline: Inline: each change's removed lines, then its added lines
setting.git.diff.layout.enum.sideBySide: Side by side, aligned row by row
setting.git.diff.layout.title: Diff Layout
setting.git.diff.showStagingControls.des: Show each change's Stage and Discard (or Unstage) buttons in a column of the diff, between the line numbers and the signs. Hidden, the commands are still on the code's context menu.
setting.git.history.showAllBranches.desc: In the Git Repository window, show the commits of every branch in one graph instead of the selected branch's. Its toolbar toggles it.
setting.git.history.showRemoteBranches.d: Show remote branches in the history's Branch / Tag column. The history's toolbar toggles it.
setting.git.history.showTags.description: Show tags in the history's Branch / Tag column. The history's toolbar toggles it.
setting.git.history.showTags.title: History: Show Tags
setting.git.mergeEditor.incomingOnLeft.d: Show the incoming version on the left and the current one on the right. Off: the current version on the left.
setting.git.mergeEditor.incomingOnLeft.t: Merge Editor: Incoming on the Left
setting.git.mergeEditor.layout.descripti: How the merge editor arranges the incoming and current versions and the result. Its gear menu changes it too.
setting.git.mergeEditor.layout.enum.sour: The two versions side by side, the result below them
setting.git.mergeEditor.layout.enum.thre: Three columns, the result in the middle
setting.git.mergeEditor.layout.title: Merge Editor Layout
setting.hosting.ciStatus.description: Show the checks, pipelines or builds of the current branch, beside the branch and in Git Changes.
setting.hosting.ciStatus.title: Show CI Status
setting.hosting.enabled.description: Talk to GitHub, Azure DevOps and GitLab (pull requests, checks, work items) for the hosts you sign in to. Off: no hosting call is made.
setting.hosting.enabled.title: Git Hosting Integration
setting.hosting.reviewComments.descripti: Show the review comments of the current branch's pull request at their lines.
setting.hosting.reviewComments.title: Show Review Comments in the Editor
setting.hosting.showResolvedComments.des: Also show resolved review threads in the editor.
setting.hosting.statusRefreshSeconds.des: How often the CI status and the branch's pull request are read again while signed in.
setting.json.schemaDownload.description: Download schemas from SchemaStore.org (cached for a week) for JSON and YAML files without a bundled schema. Takes effect after a restart.
setting.json.schemaDownload.title: Download JSON Schemas
setting.keyboard.scheme.description: Default: the classic IDE shortcuts (F6 builds, Ctrl+Q searches, Ctrl+, goes to anything, F1 is help). VS Code: VS Code's (F1 is the command palette, Ctrl+, opens Settings, Ctrl+W closes). ReSharper: the default with ReSharper's (Ctrl+Shift+R refactors, Ctrl+W expands the selection, Alt+F7 finds usages). Emacs: the default with Emacs's editing keys (Ctrl+F/B/N/P move, Ctrl+K kills to the line's end, Ctrl+Space sets the mark, Ctrl+X Ctrl+S saves, Alt+X runs a command). Your own key bindings apply on top of any of them.
setting.keyboard.scheme.title: Keyboard Scheme
setting.languageServices.analysisScope.d: Where analyzers run in the background. Compiler errors are always reported for the whole solution. The current project is the active document's, or the startup project.
setting.navigation.sourceLink.descriptio: Download the original source of library code from its Source Link URL (GitHub and the like) on Go to Definition. Embedded sources are always used; otherwise the code is decompiled.
setting.navigation.sourceLink.title: Source Link
setting.npm.restoreOnOpen.description: When a trusted solution opens with a package.json whose packages aren't installed: ask, restore (npm install), or do nothing.
setting.npm.restoreOnOpen.title: Restore npm Packages on Open
setting.npm.runtime.description: The npm that runs scripts and restores packages: yours (on PATH), else the built-in Node.js; or always the built-in Node.js.
setting.npm.runtime.enum.auto: The npm on PATH, else the built-in Node.js
setting.npm.runtime.title: npm
setting.nuget.offline.description: Use only local package sources (folders) and the global packages folder in the NuGet Package Manager. Restore is not affected.
setting.nuget.offline.title: Offline
setting.output.wordWrap.description: Wrap long lines in the Output window.
setting.output.wordWrap.title: Word Wrap
setting.plugins.autoUpdate.description: Once a day, download the newer versions of plugins installed from the gallery; they apply at the next start.
setting.plugins.autoUpdate.title: Update Plugins Automatically
setting.plugins.disabled.description: The ids of plugins that don't load (the Plugins window turns them off and on). A workspace can turn more off for itself; the lists add up. Changes apply when Codalus IDE starts again.
setting.plugins.disabled.title: Turned-Off Plugins
setting.plugins.prerelease.description: Offer and update to prerelease versions of plugins.
setting.plugins.prerelease.title: Include Prerelease Plugins
setting.plugins.requireSignature.descrip: Which sources' plugin packages must be signed (checked with dotnet nuget verify).
setting.plugins.requireSignature.title: Require Signed Plugins
setting.plugins.sources.description: NuGet v3 sources (service index URLs) the Plugin Gallery searches for plugins, in order.
setting.plugins.sources.title: Plugin Sources
setting.projects.restoreOnOpen.descripti: Restore NuGet packages in the background when a trusted solution opens.
setting.projects.restoreOnOpen.title: Restore on Open
setting.references.columnWidths.descript: The widths of the References window's columns in pixels, from File to Kind (Code takes the rest), as its column splitters leave them. Empty: the default widths.
setting.references.columnWidths.title: Column Widths
setting.references.groupBy.description: How the References window groups the references. Its Group by box changes it too; List View shows them without groups.
setting.references.groupBy.title: Group By
setting.remote.autoForwardPorts.descript: In a remote window, forward ports that start listening on the remote machine (a web app's, a debug session's) to the same port here, or a free one.
setting.remote.autoForwardPorts.title: Forward Ports Automatically
setting.run.console.description: Where console and web apps run: their output in the Output window, the integrated terminal (they can read input), or a console window of their own (Windows, the default there).
setting.run.console.title: Console for Run Without Debugging
setting.run.externalConsole.description: Windows only: start console apps in a console window of their own (so they can read input) instead of showing their output in the Output window.
setting.run.externalConsole.title: Run Console Apps in an External Console
setting.run.hotReload.description: Run under dotnet watch on Ctrl+F5: saved edits are applied to the running app, which restarts when an edit can't be applied.
setting.run.hotReload.title: Hot Reload on Start Without Debugging
setting.settingsSync.ignoredSettings.des: Settings that stay on this machine (the sync settings always do), such as paths that differ between machines.
setting.settingsSync.target.description: Where your settings, keyboard shortcuts, snippets and saved layouts sync: a folder (one a cloud drive syncs) or a Git repository's URL (a gist's clone URL works). Empty: sync is off. Each profile has its own.
setting.settingsSync.target.title: Sync Target
setting.solutionExplorer.showMembers.des: C# and Visual Basic files expand into the types and members they declare; choosing one goes to it.
setting.solutionExplorer.trackActiveItem: Selects the active document in Solution Explorer as you switch documents, as Sync with Active Document does.
setting.taskList.tokens.description: Comment tokens the Task List collects (a comment starting with one of them).
setting.taskList.tokens.title: Task List Tokens
setting.templates.defaultLocation.descri: Folder for new solutions and projects when no solution is open. Empty: a 'source/repos' folder in your home folder.
setting.templates.defaultLocation.title: Default Location
setting.terminal.commandsToSkipShell.des: Command ids whose key bindings keep working while a terminal has focus; every other key goes to the shell. Empty: the built-in list (palette, F6, build, run, debug, terminal commands).
setting.terminal.copyOnSelect.descriptio: Copy selected text to the clipboard as soon as the selection ends.
setting.terminal.copyOnSelect.title: Copy on Selection
setting.terminal.defaultProfile.descript: The shell new terminals start. Empty: the first one found.
setting.terminal.defaultProfile.title: Default Profile
setting.terminal.fontFamily.description: Fonts for the terminal, comma-separated; empty uses the editor's font.
setting.terminal.fontFamily.title: Font Family
setting.terminal.fontSize.description: Font size in points; 0 uses the editor's size.
setting.terminal.fontSize.title: Font Size
setting.terminal.scrollback.description: Lines kept above the screen in each terminal (new terminals).
setting.terminal.scrollback.title: Scrollback
setting.terminal.shellIntegration.descri: Start bash, zsh and PowerShell with a script that reports the current directory and command marks (new terminals).
setting.terminal.shellIntegration.title: Shell Integration
setting.testing.historyLength.descriptio: How many earlier results of each test the Test Explorer keeps (shown in its details).
setting.testing.historyLength.title: Results Kept per Test
setting.testing.showExplorerOnRun.descri: Open the Test Explorer when a test run starts from a command or the editor.
setting.testing.showExplorerOnRun.title: Show Test Explorer When Running Tests
setting.update.channel.description: Stable releases, or nightly builds of the next version. Empty: the channel the installed build came from. Moving from nightly builds to stable releases installs the newest stable release, even when it is older, after a confirmation.
setting.update.channel.title: Update Channel
setting.update.mode.description: Installed builds keep themselves up to date: download new releases in the background and apply them when the IDE restarts, only say that one is available, or don't check at all (no update traffic; Help → Check for Updates still works). Development builds never check.
setting.update.mode.enum.auto: Download in the background and update at the next restart
setting.update.mode.enum.notify: Say that a release is available
setting.update.mode.title: Updates
setting.web.eslint.description: Lint JavaScript and TypeScript files with the project's own ESLint, where an ESLint configuration covers them (with the web language servers).
setting.web.eslint.title: ESLint
setting.web.languageServers.description: HTML, CSS, JavaScript and TypeScript editing uses language servers that run on Node.js, downloaded once into the cache folder: ask before downloading, download without asking, or don't use them.
setting.web.languageServers.enum.ask: Ask the first time a web file opens
setting.web.languageServers.title: Web Language Servers
setting.web.prettier.description: Format Document and format on save use the project's own Prettier when it is installed (node_modules) and configured (.prettierrc, prettier.config.js or package.json).
setting.web.prettier.title: Prettier
setting.windowsForms.openInDesigner.desc: A form's or user control's code file opens in the Windows Forms designer (on Windows); View Code (F7) shows the code. Off, it opens as code and View Designer (Shift+F7) shows the designer.
setting.workbench.colorCustomizations.de: Colors over the theme's for the editor (VS Code's ids, such as "editor.selectionBackground") and the window (resource keys such as "Shell.Background"); under "[Dark]" for one theme only. Tools → Fonts and Colors edits them.
setting.workbench.colorTheme.description: The theme family and its variant: "classic" follows the operating system's light, dark or high-contrast setting, "classic.dark" stays dark. The families are Classic (Blue, Light, Dark and High Contrast; the default), Harbor, Graphite, Daylight and Ember. Plugins can add themes.
setting.workbench.colorTheme.enum.follow: Classic (follows the system; the value before 0.3)
setting.workbench.colorTheme.title: Color Theme
setting.workbench.commandBarCustomizatio: Commands added to and removed from menus, context menus and the standard toolbar, their order, and your own toolbars: { "locations": { "menuBar/tools": { "add": [], "remove": [], "order": [] } }, "toolbars": { "Name": [] } }. Tools → Customize edits it.
setting.workbench.editor.colorTabsByProj: Mark each document tab with its project's color, a stripe along the tab's bottom edge.
setting.workbench.editor.pinnedTabsOnSep: Show a document group's pinned tabs on a row of their own, above its other tabs.
Show Pinned Tabs in a Separate Row
setting.workbench.iconTheme.description: The icons of files and folders. Plugins can add icon themes.
setting.workbench.iconTheme.title: File Icon Theme
setting.workbench.locale.description: The language of menus, commands and windows. Empty: the operating system's, when Codalus IDE has it. qps-ploc and qps-plocm are pseudo-languages for testing translations (the second lays the window out right to left). Applies at the next start.
setting.workbench.locale.title: Display Language
setting.workbench.notifications.autoHide: Seconds after which informational toasts hide (they stay in the Notifications window). 0 keeps them until dismissed.
setting.workbench.setupCompleted.descrip: Whether the first-run setup (appearance, keyboard, your settings, tools) has run for this user data folder; Done and Skip setup turn it on. Turn it off to see the setup at the next start. Help → Set Up Codalus IDE runs it any time.
setting.workbench.setupCompleted.title: First-Run Setup Completed
setting.workbench.startup.description: What Codalus IDE shows when it starts without a solution: the start window (recent solutions, create, open, clone), an empty window, or the last solution.
setting.workbench.startup.title: On Startup
setting.workbench.statusBar.visible.desc: Show the status bar at the bottom of the window.
setting.xml.schemas.description: XSD schemas that validate XML files, by a glob over their paths: { "**/*.config": "schemas/config.xsd" }. Relative schema paths are from the solution's folder. Files can also name their schemas with xsi:schemaLocation or xsi:noNamespaceSchemaLocation. Schemas are never downloaded.
setting.xml.schemas.title: XML Schemas

setupWindow.aFileExportedWithExportSetti: A file exported with Tools → Export Settings: settings, keyboard shortcuts and window layouts.
setupWindow.classicBlueIsInOptions: Classic Blue, as chosen in Options. Pick a mode to change it; Blue is in Tools → Options → Environment → Appearance.
setupWindow.codalusIdeNeedsTheDotnetSdk: Codalus IDE needs the .NET SDK to open, build and debug .NET projects, and git for source control. What's missing can be installed from here: you see exactly what runs, and nothing installs until you say yes.

setupWindow.followsYourSystem: Follows your system: light or dark, and high contrast when your system turns it on.
setupWindow.fontsColorsEditorOptionsAndS: The font, colors, editor options and shortcuts another IDE exported (Import and Export Settings).
setupWindow.importFromAnotherEditor: Bring settings, keyboard shortcuts and colors from another editor or another machine. All of it is optional, and Tools → Import Settings does it later too.
setupWindow.keepYourSettingsInAFolder: Keep your settings, keyboard shortcuts, snippets and layouts in a folder (one a cloud drive syncs) or a Git repository. If it already has settings, they replace this machine's.
setupWindow.pickAThemeAndAMode: Pick a theme and a mode. The window changes as you choose. You can switch later in Tools → Options → Environment → Appearance.
setupWindow.runsOnceTheFirstTime: Runs once, the first time Codalus IDE opens. Help → Set Up Codalus IDE runs it again.
setupWindow.skipSetupTip: Keep what's chosen so far and go on (Esc). Help → Set Up Codalus IDE runs the setup again.
setupWindow.theSchemeDecidesWhatTheKeysD: The scheme decides what the keys do. Your own key bindings go over any of them. You can switch later in Tools → Options → Keyboard.
setupWindow.title: Set up Codalus IDE
setupWindow.yourSystemLead: Optional, and off unless you check them. Codalus IDE registers them for you alone when you leave this step; Tools → Options → Environment → System Integration turns them off again.
